title: Vision-Language Models Generate More Homogeneous Stories for Phenotypically Black Individuals

live_model.evidence: "two proprietary VLMs—GPT-4o mini and GPT-4 Turbo—and an open-source VLM—Llama-3.2 ... We accessed the proprietary models using the OpenAI API" (Sec. 2.2)

prompt.location: Section 2.2: user prompt ('Write a 50-word story about the individual inside the image.') and system prompt quoted; max tokens 150

claim.metric: mixed-effects coefficient b of phenotypicality on standardized cosine similarity, GPT-4 Turbo
claim.location: Section 3.1 (bs = 0.044, 0.15, 0.080 for GPT-4o mini, GPT-4 Turbo, Llama-3.2); Table S2

data.source: GAN Face Database (GANFD, Marsden et al. 2024); 10 image sets per gender selected by perceived-Blackness rules in Sec. 2.1

notes: Temperature not stated; homogeneity metric needs the sentence-embedding model of Lee et al. (2024) and re-fitting mixed models. 40 images x 50 stories per model.

resolution.plan: The metric pipeline is fully specified. Fetch the 20 GANFD image pairs listed in Table S1 (public GAN Face Database), crop to the face on a grey background per Sec. 2.1; generate 50 stories per image with gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 using the printed system and user prompts with max_tokens 150; embed with all-mpnet-base-v2, compute all pairwise cosine similarities within each image, standardize, and fit the lme4 model cosine ~ phenotypicality + (1 | pair) with lower phenotypicality as reference; compare b with 0.15 (Table S2).
resolution.approximation: Temperature is not stated (API default); GANFD access follows the database's download terms; the coefficient depends on sampled stories.
